title: Walmadjari - Wikipedia
text: July 27, 2025 - The Walmadjari (Walmajarri) people, also known as Tjiwaling and Wanaseka, are an Aboriginal Australian people of the Kimberley region of Western Australia.

title: Kankawa Nagarra - Wikipedia
text: January 10, 2026 - Kankawa Nagarra (born circa 1943), (also known as Olive Knight) is an Aboriginal Australian blues and gospel singer-songwriter and author. She sings in Walmajarri, Kimberley Creole and English. Her 2024 album Wirlmarni won the Australian Music Prize.

title: Walmajarri language - Wikipedia
text: January 1, 2026 - Walmajarri (many other names; see below) is a Pama–Nyungan language spoken in the Kimberley region of Western Australia by the Walmadjari and related peoples.
